home.heroTitle: AI-Powered Crop Advisory for Indian Farmers
home.heroSubtitle: Get scientifically validated crop recommendations suited specifically to your soil nutrient profile and local climate conditions.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Three simple steps to maximize yield and soil health
home.step1Desc: Provide soil NPK nutrients, soil pH, temperature, humidity, and expected rainfall.
home.step2Desc: Our agricultural machine learning model analyzes your inputs against 22 validated Indian crop profiles.
home.step3Desc: Receive top-3 optimal crops with confidence scores, growth insights, and agronomic guidelines.
home.modulesSubtitle: Integrated tools built specifically for modern Indian agriculture
home.crsModuleDesc: Scientifically calibrated multi-class model predicting top crops with verified high accuracy.
home.weatherModuleDesc: Live 7-day agricultural forecasts with rainfall tracking and irrigation alerts.
home.schemesModuleDesc: Direct eligibility discovery and links to central and state farmer benefit programs.
home.chatModuleDesc: 24/7 multilingual conversational advisor for crop management, pest safety, and farming queries.
home.nutritionModuleDesc: USDA-verified nutritional profiles per 100g with raw vs cooked breakdowns and side-by-side multi-crop comparison.

recommend.title: Crop Recommendation Advisory
recommend.subtitle: Enter your soil test values and climate parameters to discover the most suitable crops for your land.
recommend.resultsSubtitle: Ranked by ML model confidence based on your field's physiological suitability.
recommend.confidenceNote: Score reflects machine learning model confidence based on training data, not a yield guarantee.

nitrogen.label: Nitrogen (N)
nitrogen.tooltip: Available nitrogen in soil. Essential for leaf growth and lush green vegetation.

phosphorus.label: Phosphorus (P)
phosphorus.tooltip: Available phosphorus in soil. Crucial for root development, flowering, and seed formation.

potassium.label: Potassium (K)
potassium.tooltip: Available potassium in soil. Enhances disease resistance, drought tolerance, and fruit quality.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.tooltip: Average temperature during the crop growing season.

humidity.label: Relative Humidity
humidity.tooltip: Atmospheric moisture content affecting crop transpiration and disease risk.

ph.label: Soil pH
ph.tooltip: Acidity or alkalinity level of the soil. Optimal range for most crops is 6.0 to 7.5.

rainfall.label: Rainfall
rainfall.tooltip: Total expected precipitation or irrigation water availability during the crop cycle.
